ASUS Picasso internal headset detection

Optional property on the Qualcomm sound-card node:

- asus,disable-mbhc: Boolean. Do not start the WCD codec's internal
  multi-button headset detection on Picasso boards whose hardware does not
  use it. This prevents spurious analog-headphone insertion reports. The
  codec and other audio paths remain enabled; USB digital audio and
  Bluetooth are not controlled by this property.

  Only MBHC start is bypassed. Software initialization and teardown remain
  balanced, and no MBHC firmware work or USB-C analog notifier is started.

Example:

&lahaina_snd {
	asus,disable-mbhc;
};
